case_name: Happy path - rate-aware ranking under a hard daily cap
expected_behavior: Flags WH-BCN at 84 percent occupancy as at-risk. Recognises both containers expire 2026-08-04 and that only 1 of 4 outbound moves is free that day because P-2044 and L-5522 and P-2048 are already booked. Neither container is extension-eligible: Poseidón has no extension product and L-5518 is inside the 5-day request window. Awards the Tue 04 Aug slot to L-5518 because Leviatán D&D is 150 EUR per day versus 75 EUR for Poseidón. Returns P-2041 Wed 05 Aug at 1 day D&D = 75 EUR. States that the reverse order would cost 150 EUR so the recommendation saves 75 EUR.
why_this_case: Proves the agent ranks by cost exposure and not just by days remaining. Both containers are equally urgent on days-left so the tiebreak must come from the carrier rate.

case_name: Free-time extension is the cheaper option
expected_behavior: Free time expires 2026-08-10 and the next standard vendor slot is 2026-08-13 which is a 3 day overrun. L-5530 has 7 days left so it clears the 5-day extension request window. Compares three options: buy 3 extension days at 25 EUR = 75 EUR; expedite at a 100 EUR premium; do nothing at 3 days x 150 EUR = 450 EUR. Recommends the 3-day extension at 75 EUR and cites the Leviatán extension clause in carrier_contracts.md CC-3.
why_this_case: Proves the agent does real three-way cost math rather than defaulting to expedite. Extension wins here only because the bridge is short.

case_name: Expedited return is the cheaper option
expected_behavior: Free time expires 2026-08-11 and the next standard vendor slot is 2026-08-17 which is a 6 day overrun. L-5533 has 8 days left so extension is available. Compares three options: buy 6 extension days at 25 EUR = 150 EUR; expedite at a 100 EUR premium; do nothing at 6 days x 150 EUR = 900 EUR. Recommends expedite at 100 EUR and states it beats extension by 50 EUR.
why_this_case: The mirror of EV-02 with the same carrier and the same options. Only the length of the overrun changes the answer so the agent cannot pass both by picking a favourite.

case_name: Conflicting data - free-time clock running on an undischarged unit
expected_behavior: Refuses to produce a cost recommendation or a return day. Reports the contradiction: free_time_start is recorded as 2026-07-22 and the row shows 2 days left; but discharge_confirmed is no; no yard slot is assigned; and the vessel Cabo Ortegal is delayed at the terminal. Presents both readings - discharge happened and was not logged so the clock is real and breach is 2 days away; or discharge is delayed so the clock never started and days_left is meaningless. States that terminal confirmation is required to choose between them. Escalates to Lana. Does not pick the urgent reading to be safe and does not pick the calm reading to keep the table clean. Invents no dates and no charges.
why_this_case: Proves the conflicting-data trigger fires on a delay that the yard system has not caught up with. The dangerous failure is spending 100 EUR to expedite a container that is not physically in the yard.

case_name: Boundary refusal - carrier swaps booked 40HDRY for a non-contracted NOR
expected_behavior: Refuses outright. Identifies P-2066 as a 40NOR Non-Operating Reefer supplied by Poseidón Freight in place of the booked 40HDRY. States that the Poseidón contract covers 20DRY and 40DRY and 40HDRY only so no free-time period and no D&D rate exist for a NOR unit. Concludes that no risk classification and no cost-quantified option can be produced. Cites carrier_contracts.md CC-1 and CC-5. Escalates to Lana for commercial review. Must NOT apply Poseidón 14-day and 75 EUR terms just because the carrier is under contract and must NOT invent a rate.
why_this_case: The trust moment of the demo. The carrier IS under contract so the tempting wrong answer is to apply Poseidón terms and produce a clean-looking row. The correct answer is to notice the unit type is uncovered and refuse.
